kjv: their (Israel's) spot is not the spot of his (Yahweh's) children
mine: they (Israel) are no longer his (Yahweh's) children because of their blemish
note: shichet lo lo' banav mumam is one of the most corrupt lines in the Hebrew Bible. Every rendering reconstructs it; the KJV supplies words in italics.

kjv: he (Yahweh) led him (Jacob) about, he instructed him
mine: he (Yahweh) encircled him (Jacob), he cared for him
note: yesovevenhu means "surrounded/shielded him" and yevonenehu means "watched over him". "Instructed" over-reads binah.

kjv: with the fat of kidneys of wheat
mine: with the very finest of the wheat
note: chelev kilyot chittah is an idiom ("kidney-fat of wheat") for the choicest grain. The KJV renders it literally.

kjv: They (Israel) sacrificed unto devils, not to God
mine: They (Israel) sacrificed to demons that were no gods
note: shedim are demons or spirits. lo' 'eloah means "not-god", not a contrast with the true God.

kjv: devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction
mine: devoured by plague and poisonous pestilence
note: reshef and qetev may be pestilence demons (cf. the Canaanite god Resheph), not "burning heat".

kjv: lest their (Israel's) adversaries should behave themselves strangely
note: yenakkeru means "misconstrue, misread" what happened, not "act strangely".

kjv: the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants
mine: Yahweh will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants
note: yadin here means "vindicate" (parallel to having compassion), not condemn. yitnecham means "relent / have compassion".

kjv: from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy
mine: from the long-haired heads of the enemy
note: mero'sh par'ot 'oyev: par'ot is probably "long locks" (of warriors; cf. Judg 5:2), not "revenges".

kjv: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his (Yahweh's) people
mine: Rejoice, O nations, with his (Yahweh's) people
note: Both follow the short Masoretic text. The Dead Sea Scrolls (4QDeut-q) and the Septuagint have a longer verse that includes "let all the sons of God worship him", which is quoted in Hebrews 1:6. Similarly, at v. 8 the scrolls read "sons of God" where the MT has "sons of Israel".
